checklists.name: Java Engineering Standards
checklists.description: Validation checklist for Java 17/21 standards, Spring Boot architecture, static analysis, and JUnit testing.

items.statement: Modern Java language constructs (records, sealed classes, pattern matching, switch expressions) are used over verbose boilerplate.
Spring dependency injection uses constructor injection rather than field injection (@Autowired on fields is avoided).
JPA/Hibernate queries avoid N+1 issues via JOIN FETCH or Entity Graphs, and transactions specify proper read-only flags.
Static analysis via Checkstyle, SpotBugs, and SonarQube returns zero high-severity code smells or security flaws.
Unit tests use JUnit 5 and AssertJ / Mockito with high branch coverage and isolated test slices.
